source.released_tg1a_checkpoint_role: fixed-checkpoint content-use evidence only; excluded from matched TG4 training contrasts because its processed robotwin_eef_30hz data and complete optimization recipe are unavailable
source.external_pure_vla_baseline: accepted official pi0.5 A0; descriptive baseline only and excluded from the within-architecture causal contrasts

question: Which combination of LaWAM policy pretraining, downstream future auxiliary loss, and inference-time future conditioning accounts for closed-loop utility under one matched RoboTwin training protocol?

training.data_order: in_order=true with mixture RNG seeded by training seed; exact rank hashes equal across arms within seed and distinct across seeds
training.selection: fixed final step 20000; no checkpoint or arm selection from outcomes

clean_base.initialization: Qwen3-VL base plus the common frozen LAM feature module; no lawam_pretrain policy checkpoint; random policy flow

auxiliary_only.role: downstream representation shaping without inference conditioning

conditioning_only.role: future conditioning trained only through action loss

parameter_matched_null.flow_condition: zero with zero tether retaining the future graph
parameter_matched_null.role: shared parameter-matched reference for route main effects

full.role: accepted matched full route subject to fixed-checkpoint content intervention

integrity_gates_before_evaluation: all 18 jobs terminate successfully at exactly step 20000 with optimizer state
parameter and trainable trees match across all six arms
initialization payloads match among the five lawam_pretrain arms within each seed; clean_base differs only by the prespecified initialization
four rank data-order hashes match across all six arms within each seed
each rank data-order hash differs across training seeds
all non-arm config fields and dataset statistics match

prespecified_contrasts.content_use: full_normal - full_shuffled at each fixed checkpoint

statistics.claim_gate: positive hierarchical 95% CI lower bound and Holm-adjusted paired p < 0.05
statistics.task_safety: no claimed winning arm may regress more than 5 percentage points on any training-seed/task cell
statistics.reporting: publish every training-seed/task effect and every negative effect; macro means cannot hide regressions

stop_rules: Do not inspect partial rollouts or intermediate checkpoints to change the arm set, seeds, steps, target, or contrasts.
Reject the complete matrix before evaluation if any integrity gate fails; do not repair and reuse a partially observed matrix.
A positive released-checkpoint TG1A result cannot substitute for a failed matched TG4 contrast.
Do not attribute pure-VLA improvement from pi0.5 versus LaWAM because architectures differ.
